name: Onboard a customer
description: Open a business relationship: collect identity data, verify it, classify risk, and register the lawful basis for the personal data processed.

name: Handle high-risk relationships
description: Manage relationships flagged high-risk: PEPs, high-risk third countries, complex structures.

name: Monitor transactions
description: Screen and scrutinise transaction flows against the customer's expected profile.

name: Process personal data
description: Any collection, storage, use or sharing of personal data across products and internal systems.

name: Respond to security & data incidents
description: Detect, contain, classify and notify security incidents, data breaches and ICT disruptions.

name: Custody client crypto-assets
description: Hold, or control the means of access to, clients' crypto-assets and fiat funds.

name: Outsource ICT services
description: Contract cloud and other ICT services supporting critical or important functions.

name: Keep records
description: Retain CDD, transaction and processing records for their statutory periods and delete defensibly afterwards.

name: Run the business risk assessment
description: Produce and refresh the business-wide ML/TF risk assessment that calibrates the rest of the programme.
